note: Birth places the automatic geocoder could not place, positioned by hand so they appear on the Origins map. Loaded into geocode_cache at start-up with status 'manual'. Never overwrites a place the geocoder found, or one somebody placed by hand in the database; a place from this file is refreshed if its entry here changes. Positions are the town or village centre as it stands now. Where the census text is ambiguous the note says which place was chosen.

places.label: Dudley, West Midlands
places.note: The 1901 return gives Staffordshire. Dudley was surrounded by Staffordshire but was not in it - it was a detached part of Worcestershire. Asked for "Dudley, Staffordshire" the geocoder answered a nature reserve at Himley, six kilometres west.

places.label: Dudley, West Midlands
places.note: Dudley was a detached part of Worcestershire until 1966 and is in the West Midlands now. Asked for "Dudley, Worcestershire" the geocoder answered a spot in the COTSWOLDS, fifty-five kilometres south, having matched "Worcestershire (detached)" and ignored Dudley altogether. The 1901 enumerator wrote Staffordshire, which is where it looks on a map but not where it was.
